title: Bozeman, MT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Bozeman, MT: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Bozeman is a city in MT with a population of 54,000. Gallatin Valley gateway to Yellowstone with Montana State University and a booming tech scene. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.6.
